fullscreen.description: Start in fullscreen mode; suppresses the window title bar

background_color.description: Background fill colour as a 6-digit RGB hex string without a leading # (e.g. 000000 for black, 1a1a2e for dark navy)

font_size.description: Point size of the font used to render URL and host labels on screen

padding.description: Pixel spacing between adjacent request balls sharing the same time slot

gutter_width.description: Width in pixels of the left-hand column used to display host and group labels

paddle_mode.description: How paddles are partitioned: 'single' (one for all traffic), 'pid' (one per server worker process), 'vhost' (one per virtual host)

paddle_position.description: Vertical centre of the paddle area as a fraction of screen height (0.0 = top, 1.0 = bottom)

hide_paddle.description: Hide the paddle bar — useful for purely decorative / kiosk installations

hide_url_prefix.description: Omit the protocol and hostname from URL labels, showing only the path

hide_response_code.description: Do not render the HTTP response-code badge (200, 404, 500 …) on each ball

hide_progress.description: Hide the playback-progress bar shown at the bottom of the screen

speed.description: Log replay speed multiplier: 1.0 = real-time, values above 1.0 speed up playback

sync.description: Synchronise replay to wall-clock time — overrides speed; recommended when tailing a live log

disable_auto_skip.description: Disable automatic jumping over long idle gaps in the log; preserves natural timing

start_position.description: Number of seconds into the log at which to begin playback; omit to start from the first entry

stop_position.description: Fraction of total log length (0.0–1.0) at which to stop playback; omit to play to the end

log_format.description: Access-log format logstalgia should parse: combined, common, vhost_combined, squid, or w3c

max_connects.description: Maximum number of in-flight request balls displayed simultaneously; raise for busy sites

label_truncation.description: Truncate URL and host labels to this many characters; 0 disables truncation

output_ppm_stream.description: Write raw PPM video frames to stdout so the stream can be piped into ffmpeg for recording

output_framerate.description: Frame rate in fps for the PPM output stream (only active when output_ppm_stream is true)

groups.description: Request-grouping rules: each entry colours and labels balls whose URL matches the given regex

regex.description: POSIX extended regular expression matched against the full request URL path

label.description: Short display name shown on screen for this group (e.g. 'Static Assets', 'API')

color.description: Ball colour for this group as a 6-digit RGB hex value without a leading # (e.g. ff6600 for orange)
